fib: ______ means transferring the policy by the assured who is called the "assignor" to a third party called the "assignee" so as to enable the assignee to enforce the policy in his own name.

Assignment of policy of insurance means transferring the policy by the assured who is called the "assignor" to a third party called the "assignee" so as to enable the assignee to enforce the policy in his own name.
______ is a charge by which the assured undertakes to do a particular thing or satisfy a particular condition or affirms or negates the existence of a particular state of facts.
Warranty is a charge by which the assured undertakes to do a particular thing or satisfy a particular condition or affirms or negates the existence of a particular state of facts.
______ is a fundamental term of the contract, the breach of which entitles the other party to rescind the contract and claim for damages.
A condition is a fundamental term of the contract, the breach of which entitles the other party to rescind the contract and claim for damages.
______ is a loss falling generally on all interest involved in a maritime venture as distinguished from particular average or a loss falling on one particular interest.
General average is a loss falling generally on all interest involved in a maritime venture as distinguished from particular average or a loss falling on one particular interest.
______ is a personal contract and does not run with the subject matter of the insurance.
A policy of insurance is a personal contract and does not run with the subject matter of the insurance.
